title: 官方天津 V4：独立统计审查
design_timing: allocation_readout is selected as this new stage primary after inspecting prior V1/V2/V3 and SWEWT supplement results, before any model prediction/performance output for the newly acquired official 2023-2026 tail. This does not rename the old V3 primary or make this model design globally preregistered.

checks: mean-seed and ensemble estimands differ as intended
known paired effect under both20/40 circular observed-origin blocks

scientific_assessment.note: Per-contrast numerical interval indicators, not a publication rule or evidence that every market is confirmed.
scientific_assessment.interpretation: Primary allocation_readout and constant have exactly identical predictions because both retained epoch0. All six structural families retained their native initial parameters; all three seed refits had zero optimizer updates and identical predictions. The prespecified positive comparisons with RW/SWEWTfull support this selected fixed forecast rule on the official later Tianjin sample, not incremental learning of the allocation module here. Validation-selected ridge_price has a lower point risk and remains reported.

limitations: Primary candidate selected after old V3/SWEWT outcomes, before this official new-tail forecast evaluation; old V3 identities unchanged.
One official Tianjin later period, not new-market population confirmation. Test dates became exposed after this run.
All official rounded prices retained. Current historical snapshot lacks certified daily vintages; no author ScienceDB monthly cleaning is newly imposed.
196 irregular observed origins, overlapping H20 labels, circular-block and percentile approximation;20 primary and40 sensitivity both retained.
Three primary and two secondary contrasts jointly comprise the five-family Bonferroni set; no seeds treated as independent observations and no horizon-specific tests added.
Condition on fitted models and recorded validation choices; does not retroactively correct every old development search.
Gradient counts reconstructed from hash-matched execution logs and optimizer-call bounds, not independent backward-pass replay.
Checkpoint bytes checked without unpickling; trained checkpoint validation predictions not replayed by this audit.
Useful fixed initialization differs from learned improvement; softplus and affine controls differ in optimization geometry as well as sign freedom.
No arbitrary1% gate and no publication-success guarantee.

post_execution_initialization_identity_c.classification: deterministic post-execution forecast/receipt identity check; no new hypothesis test or model fit
